name: VenueDesk — Run Migration 010 (Payments & Recurring Schema Fixes)

nodes.name: DB: Step 1 — fix payments booking_id nullable

parameters.query:
-- Allow NULL booking_id so recurring payments can be recorded without a specific booking
ALTER TABLE bookings.payments ALTER COLUMN booking_id DROP NOT NULL;

nodes.name: DB: Step 2 — add missing payments columns
DB: Step 3 — add sessions_per_cycle and agreed_price to recurring_rules

parameters.query:
-- sessions_per_cycle: number of sessions in one billing cycle (weekly=4, fortnightly=2, monthly=1)
ALTER TABLE bookings.recurring_rules ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sessions_per_cycle INT;
ALTER TABLE bookings.recurring_rules ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS agreed_price       NUMERIC(10,2);

-- Backfill sessions_per_cycle from frequency for existing rules
UPDATE bookings.recurring_rules
SET sessions_per_cycle = CASE frequency
    WHEN 'fortnightly' THEN 2
    WHEN 'monthly'     THEN 1
    ELSE 4  -- weekly (default)
  END
WHERE sessions_per_cycle IS NULL;

-- Backfill agreed_price = monthly_fee if not set
UPDATE bookings.recurring_rules
SET agreed_price = monthly_fee
WHERE agreed_price IS NULL AND monthly_fee IS NOT NULL AND monthly_fee > 0;

-- Fix recurring_payment_schedule rows where amount_due was stored as session_price
-- (i.e. amount_due <= rate_per_session, meaning it was NOT multiplied by sessions_per_cycle)
-- Update to the correct cycle price.
UPDATE bookings.recurring_payment_schedule rps
SET amount_due = COALESCE(
    NULLIF(rr.agreed_price, 0),
    NULLIF(rr.monthly_fee, 0),
    rr.rate_per_session * CASE rr.frequency
      WHEN 'fortnightly' THEN 2
      WHEN 'monthly'     THEN 1
      ELSE 4
    END
  )
FROM bookings.recurring_rules rr
WHERE rps.recurring_rule_id = rr.id
  AND rps.status = 'pending'
  AND rr.rate_per_session IS NOT NULL
  AND rr.rate_per_session > 0
  AND rps.amount_due > 0
  -- Only update rows where amount_due looks like a session price (not a cycle price)
  -- i.e. amount_due roughly equals rate_per_session (within 1p tolerance)
  AND ABS(rps.amount_due - rr.rate_per_session) < 0.01;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns
   WHERE table_schema='bookings' AND table_name='payments' AND column_name='customer_id') AS pay_has_customer_id,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns
   WHERE table_schema='bookings' AND table_name='payments' AND column_name='tenant_id') AS pay_has_tenant_id,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns
   WHERE table_schema='bookings' AND table_name='payments' AND column_name='series_reference') AS pay_has_series_ref,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns
   WHERE table_schema='bookings' AND table_name='recurring_rules' AND column_name='sessions_per_cycle') AS rr_has_sessions_per_cycle,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns
   WHERE table_schema='bookings' AND table_name='recurring_rules' AND column_name='agreed_price') AS rr_has_agreed_price,
  (SELECT is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns
   WHERE table_schema='bookings' AND table_name='payments' AND column_name='booking_id') AS booking_id_nullable;
